role: Staring task: on a small chance draw the mob finds the nearest watched entity (the player, or a class query) within maxDistance and turns its head toward it for 40-80 ticks.

members.name: theWatcher
members.note: folded: the task runs on the owning struct living

members.name: closestEntity
members.note: ai_task.target; the player case is folded (is_watching_player) because the engine's single player is not a struct living

members.name: shouldExecute
members.note: vanilla's attack-target shortcut is a dead store: the class query overwrites closestEntity on the next line, so skipping it is exact; getClosestPlayer's distance test is strict (a player at exactly maxDistance is not found; trade-full-s1 row 21, lane/villagetrade)

members.name: continueExecuting
members.note: lookTime > 0 and the target (or player) within maxDistance; the aliveness check covers the non-player cases

members.name: updateTask
members.note: looks at the target (its eye height) or the player (1.62) at 10/40, --lookTime

notes: The villager's watch-other-living entry (watch_class 2) queries any living with kind -1; EntityAIWatchClosest2 shares the same case under AIC_WATCH_CLOSEST2.
